derivation: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;
def: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert

occurrences.text: And they removed from Bene–jaakan, and encamped at Hor–hagidgad.
